(SETQ A (*ARRAY () T 100.))
(LEXPR-FUNCALL A '(10.)) gives 
;((NIL 12) (NIL . 0)) TOO MANY ARGUMENTS SUPPLIED - APPLY

This hardly seems fair. 
(APPLY A '(10.))
and
(FUNCALL A 10.)
work fine. Hence, we're losing on arrays' consistency as funcallable.
